instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/hole_group_part.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Identify and group twenty-four holes into through holes, blind holes, counterbores, and threaded pilot holes. Create evaluable Drilling, Helix, and Thread Mill toolpaths for the hole groups using spot drill, drill, bore/circle mill, and thread milling or helical approximation as needed. Tool definitions: use T1 as a spot drill, T2 as a drill, T3 as a bore/circle mill, and T4 as a thread mill or helical tool for the hole groups; use S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min for these tools. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-13.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
